verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a general-purpose CLM platform with no-code contract creation, workflows, and e-signature that could technically be configured to handle offer letters or NDAs (ironclad-docs-9, ironclad-docs-10, ironclad-comm-6 mentions using it for contractor onboarding), but there is no evidence of purpose-built templates, workflows, or integrations for hiring/equity paperwork specifically, especially option grants which typically require cap-table integration. Missing for 10: dedicated HR/equity templates, option grant or cap-table integration evidence, and any case study showing legal-ops running full hiring paperwork through Ironclad.
